name: rename_size_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rename_size_eq : (M.rename x y).size = M.size
proof:
:= by
  induction M with
  | var _ => rw [rename, size]; split <;> rw [size]
  | app P Q hP hQ => rw [rename, size, hP, hQ, size]
  | abs _ Q hQ =>
    rw [rename, size]
    split
    · rw [size]
    next h => rw [not_or] at h; split <;> (next hx => simp [hx, hQ])

name: renaming_rename
statement:
@[simp]
theorem renaming_rename {x y : Name} {M : Λ} {hfv : y ∉ (FV M)} {hnb : ¬ M.HasBindingVar y} : Renaming (abs x M) (abs y (rename M x y))
proof:
:=
  Renaming.rename x y M hfv hnb

name: subst_noop
statement: theorem subst_noop (h : x ∉ M.FV) : M.subst x N = M
proof:
:= by
  induction M with
  | var y =>
    rw [subst]
    rw [FV, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
    exact if_neg h
  | app P Q ihP ihQ =>
    rw [FV, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at h
    rw [subst, app.injEq]
    exact ⟨ihP h.left, ihQ h.right⟩
  | abs y P ihP =>
    rw [FV] at h
    rw [subst]
    if hxy : x = y then
      simp [hxy]
    else
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
      simp [hxy] at h
      simp [hxy]
      exact (fun _ _ => ihP h)

name: nf_beta_imp_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nf_beta_imp_eq (h : M.InNormalForm) (hmn : M →β N) : M = N
proof:
:= by
  induction hmn with
  | redex M N =>
    rw [InNormalForm, Redex] at h
    rw [not_true_eq_false, false_and] at h
    contradiction
  | @compatAppLeft L M N _ IH =>
    exact congrFun (congrArg app (IH h.right.left)) L
  | @compatAppRight L M N _ IH =>
    exact congrArg (app L) (IH h.right.right)
  | @compatAbs x M N _ IH =>
    exact congrArg (abs x) (IH h)

name: nf_beta_chain_imp_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nf_beta_chain_imp_eq (h : M.InNormalForm) (hmn : M ↠β N) : M = N
proof:
:= by
  induction hmn with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail hlm hmn IH =>
    cases hlm
    · exact nf_beta_imp_eq h hmn
    · subst IH; exact nf_beta_imp_eq h hmn

name: fixpoint
statement: theorem fixpoint {x : Name} (L : Λ) (h : x ∉ L.FV) : ∃ M : Λ, app L M =β M
proof:
:= by
  let U := lam x ↦ L ∙ (x ∙ x)
  let M := U ∙ U
  have : M →β (L ∙ (x ∙ x)).subst x U := Beta.redex ..
  simp [subst, subst_noop h] at this
  exact ⟨M, .betaInv this⟩

name: Finset.diff_subset_iff
statement: theorem Finset.diff_subset_iff {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {s t u : Finset α} : s \ t ⊆ u ↔ s ⊆ t ∪ u
proof:
:=
  show s \ t ≤ u ↔ s ≤ t ∪ u from sdiff_le_iff

name: context_free_variables
statement: theorem context_free_variables {Γ : Context} {L : Term} {σ : Typ} (J : Γ ⊢ L : σ) : L.FV ⊆ dom Γ
proof:
:= by
  induction J with
  | @var _ _ α h =>
    simp [Term.FV, dom]
    exact ⟨α, h⟩
  | app jM jN ihM ihN =>
    simp [Term.FV]
    apply Finset.union_subset
    · exact ihM
    · exact ihN
  | abs Δ' ihM =>
    simp [Term.FV]
    simp [dom_insert_eq_insert_dom] at ihM
    exact Finset.diff_subset_iff.mpr ihM

name: generation_var
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generation_var {Γ : Context} {x : Name} {σ : Typ} : (Γ ⊢ x : σ) ↔ (x, σ) ∈ Γ
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro h; cases h; assumption
  · apply Judgement.var

name: generation_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generation_app {Γ : Context} {M N : Term} {τ : Typ} : (Γ ⊢ M ∙ N : τ) ↔ (∃ σ : Typ, (Γ ⊢ M : σ ⇒ τ) ∧ (Γ ⊢ N : σ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro h; cases h; case mp.app σ hn hm => exact ⟨σ, ⟨hm, hn⟩⟩
  · intro h; cases h; case mpr.intro σ h => exact Judgement.app h.left h.right

name: generation_abs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generation_abs {Γ : Context} {x : Name} {M : Term} {σ ρ : Typ} : (Γ ⊢ Term.abs x σ M : ρ) ↔ (∃ τ : Typ, ((insert (x, σ) Γ) ⊢ M : τ) ∧ ρ = (σ ⇒ τ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro h; cases h; case mp.abs τ h => exact ⟨τ, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro h; cases h; case mpr.intro τ h => rw [h.right]; exact Judgement.abs h.left

name: subterm
statement: theorem subterm {M : Term} (h : Legal M) : ∀ N, N ⊆ M → Legal N
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN
  cases h with
  | intro Γ h =>
    obtain ⟨ρ, J⟩ := h
    induction J with
    | @var Δ x α h =>
      simp at hN
      subst hN
      exact ⟨Δ, α, Judgement.var h⟩
    | @app Δ P Q α β jP jQ ihP ihQ =>
      simp [Legal]
      simp at hN
      cases hN with
      | inl h => subst h; exact ⟨Δ, β, Judgement.app jP jQ⟩
      | inr h => cases h with
        | inl h => simp at ihP; exact ihP h
        | inr h => simp at ihQ; exact ihQ h
    | @abs Δ x P α β Δ' ih =>
      simp [Legal]
      simp at hN
      cases hN with
      | inl h => subst h; exact ⟨Δ, (α ⇒ β), Judgement.abs Δ'⟩
      | inr h => simp at ih; exact ih h
